title: Zakariyya's Persistent Supplication
paragraphs: Well into old age without a child despite years of sincere supplication, Prophet Zakariyya continued praying persistently for a righteous heir, never allowing his advancing years to convince him that his request had become unreasonable.

Rather than viewing his prolonged childlessness as evidence his prayers had gone unanswered, he maintained a private, quiet consistency in his supplication, understanding that timing rested entirely with Allah rather than with his own expectations.

When the eventual answer finally arrived through unlikely circumstances, it validated a persistence that many observers might have considered unreasonable to maintain for so many years without any visible sign of progress.

This account is frequently discussed today when addressing the value of sustained supplication, illustrating that persistent hope, maintained quietly over years, sometimes precedes an answer that arrives well beyond when hope alone might expect it.
